instructions: For every `[suggestion]` thread under `## Review threads`, run one `pr-shepherd build-suggestion-patches https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42 --thread-id "<id>" --message "<one-sentence headline>" --format=json --transport rest`, repeating `--thread-id` and `--message` in displayed order. Playbook: "Suggestion patches".
Commit and push any code changes.
Journal substantial decisions or rejections, citing item URLs or review IDs: `pr-shepherd apply journal https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42 --transport rest '- <decision>'`

Set `$DISMISS_MESSAGE` to one sentence on what changed and run, even if no code changed: `pr-shepherd apply review https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42 --transport rest --reply-thread-ids PRRT_suggest --message "$DISMISS_MESSAGE" --adopt-existing-replies --require-sha "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"`
